snippet.title: Shadowstone Playtest Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Shadowstone is a tactics roguelite for up to four players from the creators of Sunderfolk. It's coming soon to PC, but if you can't wait that long, you can sign up for the upcoming playtest by heading to the Shadowstone Steam page.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4180840/Shadowstone/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
